raw_text: {"term_results":[{"rank":1,"contextual_sense":{"Translation (English)":"way; principle; Dao","Dictionary Meaning (English)":"The fundamental, ineffable principle underlying the universe and all existence, often described as the source of all things and the guiding force of nature.","Pronunciation (English)":"dào","Part of Speech (English)":"noun","Register (English)":"philosophical, literary, classical","Nuance (English)":"Implies a cosmic order that is beyond human comprehension and cannot be fully expressed in language."},"additional_senses":[{"Translation (English)":"to speak; to say","Dictionary Meaning (English)":"To express verbally or in writing.","Pronunciation (English)":"dào","Part of Speech (English)":"verb","Register (English)":"literary, classical","Nuance (English)":"Often used in the context of communication or discourse.","Sentences":["道者，言也。","君子之道，不可道也。","道其言，而不行其事。","道其所知，以告于人。"],"Sentence Translations (English)":["Speaking is the act of expressing.","The way of a gentleman cannot be spoken.","To speak his words, but not perform his deeds.","To speak what he knows, and tell it to others."]}],"occurrence_sense_indices":[0,1]}],"source_context_translations":[{"context_id":"source-context-c535f824d57f859c34ac","translation":"The Dao that can be spoken of is not the eternal Dao; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;" }]}
